overall_limitations: All submitted claims are supported by the packet, but several complete rubric facts are split across claims. Gold IDs are awarded only where an individual claim adequately states the complete referenced fact.
The skipped parent and sibling concepts are supported as topics by the source packet but are not developed by the submitted claims.
The packet contains differing descriptions of reader blocking for aggressive checkpoint modes; the submitted claims do not resolve that discrepancy.

Pass numbers and reported information rates do not establish depth or saturation. Several packet-supported details remain unclaimed, including fixed reader end marks, the default 1000-page threshold, attached-database iteration and reader lookup costs.
